Service

PR that earns rankings, written so a journalist will still run it.

Search optimisation and newsworthiness are not opposites. They only look like opposites when someone stuffs a keyword into a headline that nobody would ever write.

Submit a releaseRead the SEO PR guide
Quick answer SEO PR is the practice of writing and distributing press releases so they rank in search results and earn editorial backlinks, without compromising newsworthiness. PressCosmos maps each release to search intent, uses the target phrase naturally in the headline and first paragraph, and reports the backlinks and rankings it produced.

Method

Five things we optimise, in order

  1. 01

    Intent, not volume

    We start from the question a person types when they are ready to act, not the phrase with the biggest monthly volume.

  2. 02

    Headline phrasing

    The target phrase goes in the headline only when a human editor would have written it that way anyway.

  3. 03

    First 60 words

    Where search snippets and AI answers come from. Specific, factual, no preamble.

  4. 04

    Entity clarity

    Your organisation, the product, the location and the category named precisely and consistently.

  5. 05

    Link context

    Anchor text variance comes from how syndicating outlets naturally describe you, not from a spreadsheet.

Compliance

Why we say no to link schemes

Selling guaranteed keyword-rich dofollow links from a newswire is a paid link scheme. Search engines treat it as such, and the penalties land on your domain, not ours.

What actually works is slower and more durable: earn editorial links because the story is genuinely useful, and structure the page so search engines can understand it.

  • No hidden or client-side cloaked text
  • No keyword-stuffed anchor blocks
  • No guaranteed dofollow links sold as a product
  • Paid placements labelled as sponsored
  • Disclosed relationships on every release
  • Corrections rather than quiet edits

Get started

Write it once. Rank and get cited with the same release.

Launch in under an hour. Editorial review, distribution, monitoring and AI visibility in one place.
